title: Poisson three-folds constructed from co-Higgs bundles on Hopf surfaces
summary: This paper extends a previous work in which the rank-2 co-Higgs bundles on a Hopf surface are classified based on the data of the underlying vector bundle. The aim of the paper is to study the Poisson 3-folds that can be constructed from these co-Higgs bundles by describing their symplectic leaves.
